instruction.name: xvrotr.w
instruction.description: Rotate right each unsigned 32-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 32, store the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: Two cycles from either source. The chain feeds the rotated result back into the source through one xvadd.b (1 cycle, subtracted); chaining two rotates reads 4.00 cycles, i.e. 2 cycles each. A chain that lets the destination feed itself measures 1 cycle because the self-dependency is renamed away, so the closing arithmetic is needed to see the real latency.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvrotr.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvrotr.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvrotr.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvrotr.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvrotr.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvrotr.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvrotr.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvrotr.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -512; vld $vr1, $r20, 0; vld $vr2, $r20, 16; xvld $xr1, $r20, 0; xvld $xr2, $r20, 32' --asm 'xvrotr.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvrotr.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvrotr.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvrotr.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvrotr.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvrotr.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvrotr.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvrotr.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23'
throughput.notes: Eight independent destinations with distinct source registers; the rotate occupies the vector ALU for two cycles, so the sustained rate is 2 instructions per cycle.

notes: Vector rotate of each element: 2 cycles from the source and a sustained 2 instructions per cycle. The narrow and wide elements behave the same.
